p1.finding: Legal sustained-valid traffic produced 47 half-cycle protocol_error pulses in the 40-tile pressure run. The post-handshake beat state is combined with the still-held accepted last/data beat, and fault_event directly qualifies protocol_error, result_valid, stage1_issue and stage2_issue.
p1.evidence: The pulse never reached a sampling edge and protocol_error_q remained clear, so producer SVA passed; the independent TB sampled after each acceptance and counted the transient.
p1.impact: The interface is not glitch-clean and a combinational consumer can see a false fault or valid suppression. Existing posedge SVA is blind to it.
p1.required_fix: Register fault reporting or validate a captured beat/next-state tuple; add sub-cycle or clocking-block checks that legal handshakes cannot pulse protocol_error or retract result_valid.

p1.finding: The RTL accepts release for a zero-tile configured context and retires in 7 cycles, while 5*N+19 gives 19 and ap_retire_minimum requires at least 24.
p1.impact: The interface, performance formula and SVA disagree at N=0.
p1.required_fix: Either explicitly forbid zero-tile contexts in ready logic/contract or specify and assert the 7-cycle empty-context path separately.

p1.finding: No area-matched Fixed RTL instance or identical interface/resource comparison is present.
p1.impact: The integrated cycle counts do not establish acceleration over Fixed.

p1.finding: There is no matched DC/STA, macro-aware area, SAIF/PTPX power or energy evidence.
p1.impact: Frequency, area overhead, energy efficiency and PPA remain unmeasured.

p1.finding: The campaign uses synthetic legal configurations rather than checkpoint-derived rank3 factors, and has no trained accuracy admission or representative full trace replay.
p1.impact: Functional arithmetic is strong, but deployable numeric range, overflow safety, accuracy and workload performance are not admitted.

p2.finding: Two inserted configuration bubbles change N1 from 24 to 26 cycles.
p2.impact: Paper wording must state that 5*N+19 assumes gap-free configuration/raw service, result_ready high and N>=1.

p2.finding: The 1618-cycle pressure value is generated by a specific result_ready one-cycle-in-eight pattern.
p2.impact: It is neither an arbitrary-backpressure bound nor a worst-case latency.

p2.finding: Independent numerics cover two high-signal synthetic profiles and directed arbitration pressure, but not constrained-random configurations, formal equivalence or checkpoint distributions.
p2.impact: The result is strong module-directed evidence, not exhaustive numeric or control proof.

paper_safe_wording.admissible: A standalone integrated rank-3 ATLIF RTL module combines two ordered raw banks, an overlapped 96-product stage1, two ordered intermediate banks, a 96-CSD-product stage2, one elastic product entry and a 16-entry registered output FIFO. Exact-SHA Synopsys VCS and an independent directed reference observed zero sampled-edge numeric or ordering mismatches. For nonempty, gap-free, ready-high synthetic contexts, latency from first configuration-beat acceptance through release acceptance was 24 cycles for one tile and 39 cycles for four tiles, following 5N+19; one fixed one-in-eight-ready 40-tile stress schedule took 1618 cycles.
paper_safe_wording.required_caveat: The present revision has a legal-traffic combinational protocol_error/result_valid glitch and an unspecified zero-tile boundary. Results are standalone directed module cycles, not a speedup, PPA, energy, system or accuracy result.

required_next_actions: Repair and reverify the combinational protocol_error/result_valid transient before wrapper integration.
Define or reject N=0 and align ready logic, formula and SVA.
Replay checkpoint-derived rank3 factors with an accumulator-range proof and trained accuracy receipt.
Implement a matched Fixed module using the same frames, banks, FIFO, clock and port widths.
Run matched Synopsys DC/STA and SAIF/PTPX with macro-aware memory assumptions before any performance or energy claim.
